question: Who dwells in the great world above heaven?
premises: Seers, sages, and perfected beings such as Markandeya are established there.
Gods whose cosmic duties have been completed also abide there.
This world is the Great World reached above heaven.
inference: The Great World is a realm for advanced beings and for gods who have finished their appointed offices.
plain_english: In the Great World dwell seers, sages, and perfected beings such as Markandeya. Gods whose duties have come to an end also abide there.
